title: Bounded run advancing a window
statement: Let $ws$ be a Boolean word and $s\in\mathbb N$ such that its binary value is $s$, and let $d$ be a configuration in the specified entry state. Suppose tape $0$ stores $ws$ at every offset $p$ with $-1\le p\le |ws|$, and tape $2$ is blank at all those offsets. The constructed machine reaches its specified exit state at some time $t\le12(s+|ws|)+20$, never visits that exit state earlier, and up to time $t$ every work-tape head moves by at most $2s+|ws|+2$ from its initial position; at time $t$, tape $1$ has the word of $s$ false bits, one true bit, and $s$ false bits written from its initial head position, while every other configuration component agrees with $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Initial configuration $d$ has the specified entry state
